content: शंकर {%a.%} (-रा, -री|{%f.%}) [शं सुखं करोति कृ-अच्] Conferring happiness or prosperity, auspicious, propitious; भीताः शितशराभीताः शंकरं तत्र शंकरम् (मेनिरे) <ls>Ki. 15. 31</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated teacher and author (शंकराचार्य). .{@-री@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Pārvatī, wife of Śiva. .²2 Bengal madder. .²3 The Śamī tree.
